output: According to [4], for the DRA 5.0 Commuter surface option, the mass of the solar based system was over 22,000 kg for a 25 kWe system, while the nuclear power system mass was approximately 8,000 kg for a 30 kWe system. Therefore, choosing nuclear fission power would save roughly 14,000 kg (22,000 kg - 8,000 kg) compared with a solar power system.
